major_arcana.name: The Fool
major_arcana.upright_meaning: New beginnings, innocence, leap of faith
major_arcana.sports_upright: Fresh legs and fearless attacking; a debutant or returning player who treats the occasion with wide-eyed confidence
major_arcana.sports_reversed: Overconfidence; a rookie's stray pass or reckless challenge hands the opposition a free chance

major_arcana.name: The Magician
major_arcana.sports_upright: A creative hub in full flow - a maverick finalising chances and exploiting the opponent's weakest defender
major_arcana.sports_reversed: Trying to be the hero; showboating and overcomplicated passes break the team's rhythm

major_arcana.name: The High Priestess
major_arcana.sports_upright: Exceptional defensive discipline and game-reading; the back four knows every trigger before the striker moves
major_arcana.sports_reversed: A shape nobody understands; defensive comms break down and marking is lost in midfield

major_arcana.name: The Empress
major_arcana.sports_upright: Patient possession built from the back, patiently probing until a gap opens; also a productive academy
major_arcana.sports_reversed: Sterile, slow possession with no cutting edge; over-engineered attacks that never reach the box

major_arcana.name: The Emperor
major_arcana.sports_upright: A captain or manager who stamps authority on the pitch; disciplined shape, clear roles, total organisation
major_arcana.sports_reversed: Stubborn tactics with no plan B; forcing a fit player out of his natural role

major_arcana.name: The Hierophant
major_arcana.upright_meaning: Tradition, doctrine, the tried and tested
major_arcana.sports_upright: A well-drilled system doing exactly what it has done a hundred times; experience and set-piece superiority
major_arcana.sports_reversed: Clinging to a failing approach; the opposition's variations expose every outdated habit

major_arcana.name: The Lovers
major_arcana.sports_upright: Telepathic chemistry - a midfielder and a striker who finish each other's movements; combinations that look rehearsed
major_arcana.sports_reversed: Cliques in the dressing room and miscommunication on the pitch; passes that die in crowded areas

major_arcana.name: The Chariot
major_arcana.reversed_meaning: Aggression without direction, defeat, loss of control
major_arcana.sports_upright: Relentless forward momentum - the team that refuses to be pinned and keeps driving at the throat of the defence
major_arcana.sports_reversed: Reckless over-committing with the whole team upfield; permanent gaps exploited at the counter

major_arcana.name: Strength
major_arcana.sports_upright: Mental resilience; holding a lead under sustained pressure and dominating physically through the middle third
major_arcana.sports_reversed: Cracking under pressure; legs going and heads dropping the moment the game swings

major_arcana.name: The Hermit
major_arcana.sports_upright: Careful build-up, probing and patience - soaking up pressure while waiting for one clear opening
major_arcana.sports_reversed: Too passive to hurt anyone; deep and inert, waiting for a game that will never arrive

major_arcana.name: Wheel of Fortune
major_arcana.reversed_meaning: Bad luck, fated setbacks, resisted change
major_arcana.sports_upright: The momentum swing belongs to them - a deflection, a lucky bounce and a completely different game after the interval
major_arcana.sports_reversed: Own goals, deflections and refereeing decisions all going the wrong way at the crucial moment

major_arcana.name: Justice
major_arcana.sports_upright: Disciplined, legal defending; decisions won cleanly, no bookings, perfect tactical balance
major_arcana.sports_reversed: Discipline collapses - bookings, dissent, a red card and a VAR argument that costs the team its shape

major_arcana.name: The Hanged Man
major_arcana.sports_upright: A tactical reset mid-game; absorbing pressure, changing system and becoming a different team after the break
major_arcana.sports_reversed: A parked bus with no route out; time-wasting that only deepens the hole the team is already in

major_arcana.name: Death
major_arcana.sports_upright: The game-killing goal; a transformation that shuts the contest down and drains the opponent's belief
major_arcana.sports_reversed: A late collapse; a thrown-away lead, legs gone in the final quarter, the game dying when it was theirs

major_arcana.name: Temperance
major_arcana.sports_upright: Perfectly calibrated football - attack and defence in exact proportion, tempo always under control
major_arcana.sports_reversed: A lopsided team that either overruns itself or parks the bus with no middle ground

major_arcana.name: The Devil
major_arcana.sports_upright: Ruthless, suffocating pressure; opponents pinned in their own half, psychological warfare winning the war of wills
major_arcana.sports_reversed: The team walking into the opponent's trap - self-sabotage, loss of discipline, desire overriding the game plan

major_arcana.name: The Tower
major_arcana.reversed_meaning: Disaster narrowly avoided, fear of change
major_arcana.sports_upright: The upheaval arrives in the box: a collision, an injury, a goal that changes everything - or a back line that simply caves in
major_arcana.sports_reversed: Disaster hanging by a thread; surviving through damage limitation and sheer luck

major_arcana.name: The Star
major_arcana.reversed_meaning: Despair, lost belief, the light fading
major_arcana.sports_upright: The moment the stadium lifts - one inspirational strike or heroic save that turns belief back on
major_arcana.sports_reversed: Heads dropping in unison; the team stops believing in what it is attempting

major_arcana.name: The Moon
major_arcana.sports_upright: Deception and misdirection; a shape that keeps the opposition guessing, playing a different shape to the one they scouted
major_arcana.sports_reversed: The fog lifts and the game is suddenly clear; the team adapts and starts seeing the trap

major_arcana.name: The Sun
major_arcana.reversed_meaning: Glare, frustration, talent under a cloud
major_arcana.sports_upright: Peak form with everything clicking - the attacking day, the free-flowing goals, the inevitable win
major_arcana.sports_reversed: Frustration with chances going begging; a team playing well enough but unable to finish

major_arcana.name: Judgement
major_arcana.sports_upright: The redemption arc completed; a player atoning for past errors with the decisive intervention in a huge moment
major_arcana.sports_reversed: Second-guessing in front of goal; the chance taken twice and buried twice

major_arcana.name: The World
major_arcana.sports_upright: Total football; a complete performance that closes out the tie and claims the trophy
major_arcana.sports_reversed: So close it hurts - a dropped ball at the death, a point surrendered from a winning position

wands.name: Ace of Wands
wands.upright_meaning: A new creative spark; pure drive
wands.reversed_meaning: False starts; a promising move that comes to nothing
wands.sports_upright: A strike from outside the box or a dribble that beats three - a genuine spark of attacking intent
wands.sports_reversed: A promising attack that is mislaid repeatedly; sterile possession in the final third

wands.name: Two of Wands
wands.upright_meaning: Planning, choice, will held in check
wands.sports_upright: A rehearsed attack rehearsed once too often; the second attempt is telegraphed
wands.sports_reversed: Options at the feet of the attacker and none of them taken

wands.name: Three of Wands
wands.upright_meaning: Expansion, foresight, waiting to ship out
wands.sports_upright: Excellent scouting of the opposition; the counter-attack that should have been pulled two moves earlier
wands.sports_reversed: Hesitation in the box; the final pass delayed until the moment has gone

wands.name: Four of Wands
wands.sports_upright: A goal lifted the mood and lifted the team; the home crowd becomes a seventh attacker
wands.sports_reversed: Scorer silenced; unstable dressing room and a lead that stops being safe

wands.name: Five of Wands
wands.sports_upright: Competitive edge without losing discipline; the duels the team needs to win
wands.sports_reversed: Cards flying in a needless scrap; a melee that costs the better player

wands.name: Six of Wands
wands.sports_upright: A deserved, well-worked goal; the recognition that follows raises the confidence further
wands.sports_reversed: Celebrating a goal that should not have been conceded

wands.name: Seven of Wands
wands.upright_meaning: Defence of hard-won ground, standing firm
wands.reversed_meaning: Overwhelmed, giving up the high ground
wands.sports_upright: A stubborn, well-drilled defensive block that refuses to be broken down
wands.sports_reversed: The block collapses once the pressure is sustained

wands.name: Eight of Wands
wands.sports_upright: A rapid counter-attack launched the instant possession is won
wands.sports_reversed: The break never comes; the move stalls in midfield

wands.name: Nine of Wands
wands.sports_upright: Battered but still upright; the team holds on through sheer grit against waves of attacks
wands.sports_reversed: Fatally gassed; the back line starts giving ground

wands.name: Ten of Wands
wands.upright_meaning: Overload, too much to carry, collapse under load
wands.sports_upright: Everyone contributes and the workload overwhelms the opposition - or the squad, whichever lasts
wands.sports_reversed: The burden shared; fatigue turned into a collective push

wands.name: Page of Wands
wands.sports_upright: A fearless young substitute or academy player injecting energy
wands.sports_reversed: Raw inexperience; the hopeful ball that is overhit

wands.name: Knight of Wands
wands.sports_upright: The pacy forward who bursts into space and terrorises a defence that cannot handle him
wands.sports_reversed: All pace and no thought; the cross sails out and the breakdown becomes a counter

wands.name: Queen of Wands
wands.sports_upright: A magnetic playmaker who drags the ball with her and lifts the whole stadium
wands.sports_reversed: Emotional and self-doubting; the captain visibly unraveling

wands.name: King of Wands
wands.sports_upright: The leader who organises the attack and demands standards from the front
wands.sports_reversed: A leader who overruns his players and stifles the creativity around him

cups.name: Ace of Cups
cups.sports_upright: The emotional tide turns; a flowing attacking move and a goal that feels inevitable
cups.sports_reversed: Feelings choked off; the passing that should flow dies at the feet

cups.name: Two of Cups
cups.sports_upright: The two strikers finally on the same wavelength; a single movement producing a chance
cups.sports_reversed: The partnership breaks down; two strikers in each other's way

cups.name: Three of Cups
cups.reversed_meaning: Excess, over-indulgence, the group turns inwards
cups.sports_upright: Team morale at its highest; the third-man runs and shared joy on the touchline
cups.sports_reversed: Cliques and in-fighting; the dressing room turns on itself

cups.name: Four of Cups
cups.sports_upright: A team too comfortable with 1-0; the passive stretch that invites trouble
cups.sports_reversed: The mood finally lifts; the spark that reignites the chase

cups.name: Five of Cups
cups.sports_upright: The crestfallen slump after conceding; heads down, body language dying
cups.sports_reversed: The team shakes off the disappointment and gets back to work

cups.name: Six of Cups
cups.sports_upright: A return to a familiar, well-rehearsed pattern that works
cups.sports_reversed: Dwelling on past glory instead of the game in front of them

cups.name: Seven of Cups
cups.sports_upright: A team convinced of something that is not true - passing up the obvious chance
cups.sports_reversed: The fog clears; the real shape of the game is finally visible

cups.name: Eight of Cups
cups.sports_upright: The team that drifts from the contest, going through motions with nothing left
cups.sports_reversed: Pulling the team back from the precipice; motivation found at the last moment

cups.name: Nine of Cups
cups.sports_upright: The satisfying sense of a job well done; a controlled, complete performance
cups.sports_reversed: Complacency after taking the lead; satisfaction that breeds carelessness

cups.name: Ten of Cups
cups.upright_meaning: Harmony, emotional fulfilment, the happy ending
cups.sports_upright: The squad playing as one; total emotional unity and a goal that caps everything
cups.sports_reversed: Unity shattered; the emotional dressing room that falls apart

cups.name: Page of Cups
cups.sports_upright: A young creative given the freedom to express himself
cups.sports_reversed: A fanciful youngster who chases the highlight reel instead of the instruction

cups.name: Knight of Cups
cups.upright_meaning: Romance, an offer made, an emotional charge
cups.sports_upright: The dribbling midfielder whose run and cross is pure inspiration
cups.sports_reversed: Foolish promises that never become actual deliveries

cups.name: Queen of Cups
cups.sports_upright: The calm, empathetic leader who holds the team together under pressure and reads the game emotionally
cups.sports_reversed: Emotion overruns judgement; decisions made on feeling alone

cups.name: King of Cups
cups.sports_upright: The composed leader whose calm keeps a chaotic match settled
cups.sports_reversed: Emotionally repressed; a coldness that unsettles the team

swords.name: Ace of Swords
swords.sports_upright: A precise, decisive strike that cuts the defence open - the moment of tactical clarity
swords.sports_reversed: Confusion in the head; the shot blocked or the decision that makes no sense

swords.name: Two of Swords
swords.sports_upright: A standoff between two tactical minds; possession contested without a way through
swords.sports_reversed: Information finally shared and the stalemate broken

swords.name: Three of Swords
swords.sports_upright: The heartbreak of conceding - the shot that should have been saved and the silence after
swords.sports_reversed: The wound closing; the team rallies after the blow

swords.name: Four of Swords
swords.sports_upright: A halftime regroup; the tactical switch that resets the match
swords.sports_reversed: Forced rest becomes forced action; fatigue builds early

swords.name: Five of Swords
swords.sports_upright: Rowing in the dressing room or between the back four; the argument that costs concentration
swords.sports_reversed: The spat ends; everyone back on the same page

swords.name: Six of Swords
swords.sports_upright: The transitional pass that launches the counter; the team moves on from a big chance missed
swords.sports_reversed: Transition game abandoned; caught flat-footed by every break

swords.name: Seven of Swords
swords.sports_upright: A well-worked scheme executed secretly - disguise, disguise, the trap sprung on the opposition
swords.sports_reversed: The scheme is rumbled; deception that fools nobody, not least the team itself

swords.name: Eight of Swords
swords.sports_upright: A team hemmed in by the opposition's press and unable to free itself
swords.sports_reversed: The tie breaks - suddenly the whole pitch opens up

swords.name: Nine of Swords
swords.sports_upright: Nerve and dread before kick-off; the team visibly anxious and second-guessing
swords.sports_reversed: The anxiety lifts; perspective returns and the mind settles

swords.name: Ten of Swords
swords.upright_meaning: Ruin, the final blow, defeat made total
swords.sports_upright: The heavy defeat that exposes every structural flaw
swords.sports_reversed: Recovery begins; the long walk back from 0-3

swords.name: Page of Swords
swords.sports_upright: The eager young defender asking questions and reading the opposition
swords.sports_reversed: Scattered, half-thought questioning that muddies the plan

swords.name: Knight of Swords
swords.sports_upright: The pressing forward who hunts the ball with relentless intelligence
swords.sports_reversed: All charge and no thought; the foul that comes with the enthusiasm

swords.name: Queen of Swords
swords.sports_upright: The honest, analytical voice in the dressing room who sees the game exactly as it is
swords.sports_reversed: Cutting remarks that sour the team; judgement passed too harshly

swords.name: King of Swords
swords.sports_upright: The strategist at the helm; cold, clear decision-making and total tactical control
swords.sports_reversed: Intellectual tyranny; the manager who overrules the pitch

pentacles.name: Ace of Pentacles
pentacles.upright_meaning: Opportunity, a solid foundation, new resources
pentacles.reversed_meaning: Lost opportunity, poor planning, wasted talent
pentacles.sports_upright: A grounded, well-built chance that should be converted; a solid platform for the whole team
pentacles.sports_reversed: A goal that should have been taken wasted; a squad that leaves easy points on the pitch

pentacles.name: Two of Pentacles
pentacles.sports_upright: Two full-backs managing the flanks with practised balance, juggling duties without dropping a ball
pentacles.sports_reversed: Duties dropped; the flanks are turned inside out

pentacles.name: Three of Pentacles
pentacles.sports_upright: Every player executing the same plan precisely - set-piece choreography done right
pentacles.sports_reversed: Everyone running but nobody agreeing; the drill that never clicks

pentacles.name: Four of Pentacles
pentacles.upright_meaning: Possession, security, holding what is yours
pentacles.sports_upright: A compact block sitting on the ball and refusing to release it
pentacles.sports_reversed: Possession becomes hoarding; the ball is never let go

pentacles.name: Five of Pentacles
pentacles.sports_upright: A team cut off and struggling; nobody left out in the cold without a purpose
pentacles.sports_reversed: Help finally comes; the outcast is brought back in

pentacles.name: Six of Pentacles
pentacles.sports_upright: The fair exchange of effort for reward; a well-balanced squad sharing the load
pentacles.sports_reversed: The scales tipped; a star carrying a team that gives him nothing

pentacles.name: Seven of Pentacles
pentacles.reversed_meaning: Impatience, wasted effort, a poor return
pentacles.sports_upright: The long grind - working without reward and refusing to abandon the plan
pentacles.sports_reversed: Patience runs out; the effort is spent on nothing

pentacles.name: Eight of Pentacles
pentacles.sports_upright: Grinding out the unglamorous work; set-piece routines repeated until automatic
pentacles.sports_reversed: Mundane work left undone; the details that decide matches skipped

pentacles.name: Nine of Pentacles
pentacles.upright_meaning: Self-sufficiency, the reward of the work
pentacles.sports_upright: The rewards of a long campaign; a team enjoying the fruits of everything they built
pentacles.sports_reversed: Comfort so complete that nobody bothers to defend it

pentacles.name: Ten of Pentacles
pentacles.sports_upright: The weight of expectation and history; defending an inherited legacy on the pitch
pentacles.sports_reversed: The inheritance proved hollow; cracks appear under pressure

pentacles.name: Page of Pentacles
pentacles.sports_upright: The academy prospect doing his homework and finally delivering
pentacles.sports_reversed: Grounding never laid; a raw talent with no fundamentals

pentacles.name: Knight of Pentacles
pentacles.upright_meaning: Methodical labour, slow and certain progress
pentacles.sports_upright: The unglamorous workhorse who covers every blade of grass and keeps the shape intact
pentacles.sports_reversed: Dull routine; a team going through the motions

pentacles.name: Queen of Pentacles
pentacles.sports_upright: The calm, capable figure who runs the side and looks after the people in it
pentacles.sports_reversed: Carrying the whole squad on tired shoulders

pentacles.name: King of Pentacles
pentacles.sports_upright: The solid bedrock - a dominant leader who makes the side impossible to shift
pentacles.sports_reversed: Immovable and inflexible; the fortress that never modernises
